precepts.text: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them. God said, I will choose your delusion.
precepts.point: Therefore, brethren, stand fast: stand firm in his truth. And hold the traditions which ye have been taught: hold the traditions of God's laws as you've been taught, whether by word, face to face, or our epistles.

note.label: Drowning in Sin & Perdition

precepts.why:
God said it himself: “I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.” God chooses the delusion. That is the “strong delusion” of Thessalonians, sent “that they should believe a lie.”

Because you reject God’s laws in Christ, he said, I am going to send you a strong delusion, and you are going to believe a lie. That is why with these stupid faith healings everybody knows are fake, grandma for some reason can’t understand that they are fake: she has a strong delusion on her. The statue of Jesus crying, or the blood that came from the tree. There is no scripture you can pull to pull them out of that delusion, because God chose it for them when they would not answer his call.

It is the same with prayers for people who will not repent. A pastor was asked to pray for someone’s mother: no, your mama is wicked as hell; you think prayers will make your mama repent? You have to first have a willing spirit, and that is the key people keep missing. The worst one: my husband beat me, threw me down the stairs, took all my money, pray for him. Pray that he magically starts loving you? We are going to pray that you get therapy, or get the hell away from him. Where there is no willing spirit, the delusion stands.

precepts.text: A brother brought the proof of what the pleading is: for behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire. For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh.
precepts.point: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant: and I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me. Even after; even after the deliverance, there is still going to be a purge. There will still be bad actors among us that need to be purged, people that still need to get right, and Christ is the one who is going to give it to them. They shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

note.label: Forged by Fire

precepts.why:
Ezekiel says, “And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face. Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you”. This is our deliverance from Babylon: we go back into the wilderness, Christ deals with us and teaches us the laws again, and what he is doing to us there is purging.

So what kind of pleading is he going to be doing? Is it baby, baby, please? No. The pleading is killing and smiting, and Isaiah proves it: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire. For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh”. It's not a damn R&B song.

That is the same fury Ezekiel speaks of: “surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you”. As he pleaded with our fathers in the wilderness of Egypt, where the rebellious fell, he will plead with us, by fire and by the sword.

So even after the deliverance there is still going to be a purge. There will still be bad actors among us, people that still need to get right, and they are going to get it; Christ is the one who will give it to them.

precepts.text: As the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, so shall your seed and your name remain: the righteous of our people that make it. From one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me. And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched. Go forth where? To look on this place. A carcase is supposed to disappear after death; this is letting you know it is something spiritual: they are in damnation, being tormented. There is a place of torment, and it is set up when Christ returns; Christ has the power over hell and death.
precepts.point: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us. What was just went over is a secret thing that Moses understood: he understood we would be brought into spiritual Egypt, into America, and he saw America destroyed.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 29:22 speaks of “the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you”. Who is that? Isaiah 66 shows it: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.” The seed and the name that remain in the new heaven and new earth are the righteous of our people that make it, those of us that get the kingdom.

“And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.” After they come up to worship, “they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me”. Go forth where? To look on this place, America. That is the same moment Deuteronomy 29 describes, when the generation to come and the stranger from a far land see the plagues of that land, “brimstone, and salt, and burning”, and ask, “Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land?”

After somebody dies, their carcase is supposed to just disappear. So this is letting you know it is something spiritual. “for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.” They are in damnation, cast in hell, being tormented. That is why Deuteronomy 29 says the Lord will separate the man that did not repent unto evil.

There is a place of torment, and it will be set up when Christ returns. After this place is destroyed physically, a spiritual prison and damnation will be set up here, the place of torment for the devils that said, have you come to torment us before our time. Christ has the power over hell and death: he can give you life and immortality, or wake you up and torment you.

precepts.text: I will send those that escape of them, the 144,000, to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan and the isles afar off that have not heard my fame, and they bring all your brethren out of all nations to the holy mountain Jerusalem, already established, and some are taken for priests and Levites: that is the gospel preached in all the world.
precepts.point: He that endures to the end shall be saved. This gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness, and then shall the end come: that world is the 144,000, and when they are sealed the end comes.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
Remember, the 144,000 have to be sealed, and then the end comes. Isaiah shows what they do: “And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations”. Those that escape are the 144,000. He sends them “to Tarshish”, Spain; “Pul”, Libya; “and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal”, Turkey; “and Javan”, the Grecian islands; “to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory”.

There will be people who have not heard the fame of the Lord and have not seen his glory: Israelites who have not heard or seen anything, and we have to go get them. “And they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.” That is “this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations”.

You might think that is talking about now. The next verse clears it up: “And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem”. Jerusalem is already established as holy. Is Jerusalem holy today? No, there are bombs and missiles going off there. So this is not now; the kingdom is already set up.

“And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.” The brothers gathered from among those nations, the Lord will make them priests and Levites. With that, Matthew 24:14 gives a deeper understanding: the gospel preached in all the world is the work of the 144,000, and once they are sealed, the end comes.

precepts.text: The Lord comes with fire and chariots like a whirlwind to plead with all flesh, and the slain of the Lord shall be many: not just Esau, the wicked Israelites too.
precepts.point: All the tribes of the earth mourn and he sends his angels to gather his elect from the four winds: the elect is Jacob and Israel, not the Baptist church nor all races, and some Israelites who never heard still have to be fetched.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
When Christ comes after the tribulation and the war, he does not come only to gather; he comes to judge. Isaiah shows it: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.”

“For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.” All flesh. The slain of the Lord shall be many, and that is not just Esau. The wicked Israelites too.

That is why Christ is not coming tomorrow to rapture a comfortable church out of trouble. He comes with fire and sword against the nations of Idumea, and against every wicked one, including our own people who keep smoking, clubbing, and defiling the Sabbath. The powers of the heavens are shaken, his sword is bathed in heaven, and only his elect, Jacob and Israel who repented and endured, are gathered from the four winds.

precepts.text: I will send those that escape of them, the 144,000, unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan, and the isles afar off that have not heard my fame, and they shall bring all your brethren for an offering out of all nations upon horses, chariots, litters, and mules to my holy mountain Jerusalem, and I will take of them for priests and Levites. The kingdom is already set up when this happens; Papua New Guinea alone has thousands of islands.
precepts.point: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it; it is even the time of Jacob's trouble, but he shall be saved out of it. That is the great tribulation.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
How do we know we will not reach all the Israelites everywhere before Christ comes? Isaiah shows the rest are gathered after: “And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations”. Those that escape are the 144,000.

They are sent “to Tarshish”, Spain, “Pul”, Libya, “and Lud”, Lydia, “that draw the bow, to Tubal”, Turkey, “and Javan”, Greece, “to the isles afar off”, like the Melanesian isles. When we went to Papua New Guinea and looked at the map, there are thousands of islands there. These are places “that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory”: they have not heard the gospel. “and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.” The 144,000 collect the Israelites that are in these other nations.

“And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem”. The kingdom is already set up at this time, and the third temple is built.

“And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.” The brothers and sisters gathered from among those nations, the Lord will make those men priests and Levites. That is how Jacob is saved out of his trouble and all Israel is brought again to the land.

precepts.text: From one new moon to another all flesh comes to worship.
precepts.point: Only those written in the Lamb's book of life enter, the twelve tribes of Israel.

note.label: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.” This was brought up for the nations coming to Israel’s light in the kingdom.

The book, chapter and verse the Bishop was looking for is Zechariah 14, where it is spelled out: “every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.” The nations that are left come up to worship at the appointed times, keeping the high holy days. That is them coming to our light.

So all flesh coming to worship is not all flesh entering the city. They are the nations left from destruction, serving and worshipping the King at his feasts, while only those written in the Lamb’s book of life, the twelve tribes of Israel, enter the city whose everlasting light is the Lord.

precepts.text: The Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind.
precepts.point: Babylon shall be as Sodom and Gomorrah, never inhabited, only wild beasts dwelling there.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.” He comes as a whirlwind, with chariots, and his rebuke is with fire. Read on: “For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh”.

Now go back to Jeremiah 50:35 and you can visualize the sword: “A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.” The Chaldeans are the elite of the Babylonians, but it is not just the upper echelon. It is all the inhabitants of Babylon, including the Israelites that do not repent.

The sword is “upon their horses, and upon their chariots”: their tanks and planes. It is “upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her”. Is this not the great melting pot, full of thick clay heaped upon itself with all types of nations? “a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.” What they did to us will happen to them.

It is “the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols”: crazy for their idols, from the money to the structure in DC to Christianity to Americanism and the flag they wave everywhere. The fire and the sword of the Lord in Isaiah 66 is the judgment coming upon that Babylon.

precepts.text: He comes with fire and chariots like a whirlwind. Christ is going to kill a lot of people to receive his kingdom.
precepts.point: Then he called the servants: what did you do with the understanding I imparted to you?

precepts.text: Those who sanctify and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree, eating swine's flesh and the abomination, shall be consumed together, the same garden and grove worship Josiah tears down.
precepts.point: He burns the bones of the priests upon their altars and cleanses Judah and Jerusalem, and does the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, then returns to Jerusalem.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law

precepts.why:
“They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.” That is the same garden and grove worship Josiah tore down.

“And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.” “And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.”

He did the same “in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali”, and when he “had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.” Those who worshipped in the groves were consumed together, as the Lord said.

precepts.text: They shall look upon the carcasses of the men that transgressed; their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched.
precepts.point: The womb shall forget him, the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered, and wickedness shall be broken as a tree. He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not and doeth not good to the widow.

note.label: Job 24: The Crimes of the Oppressor

precepts.why:
“The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered”. Isaiah shows the end of those who have sinned: “And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.”

The worm feeds sweetly on the wicked, and their worm shall not die. As drought and heat consume the snow waters, so the grave consumes those which have sinned, and wickedness is broken as a tree. Their portion is cursed in the earth, and they are an abhorring unto all flesh.

precepts.text: The Most High comes with fire and with his chariots like a whirlwind to render his anger with fury and his rebuke with flames of fire.
precepts.point: Flood your mind with spiritual songs that prophesy within the music, like the albums coming out on Original Royalty, because the Most High wants to hear righteous songs, not the noise of the world.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.” Isaiah shows how he arrives: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.”

The chariots are the clouds he comes with, and the fire is his ministers, a flaming fire. The nuclear destruction coming on the kingdoms of the earth is the fire Christ appears with as he renders his anger with fury and his rebuke with flames of fire. Every eye shall see him, and all kindreds of the earth shall wail; and Israel sings praises to our King.

precepts.text: As the new heavens and the new earth remain before Him, so shall your seed and your name remain.
precepts.point: This is the visiting of iniquity in the regeneration; after death comes the judgment, when you reform your mind and subdue your own understanding, and you will be kept alive and obtain mercy.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
“His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me. It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven.” Isaiah gives the same measure: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.”

As the new heavens and the new earth remain before him, so shall your seed and your name remain. David's seed endures like the sun and the moon, and Israel's seed and name endure like the new heavens and the new earth. The Most High has sworn by his holiness that he will not lie unto David, and he will not alter the thing that is gone out of his lips.

precepts.text: The glory of the Most High is Israel, his servants who keep his laws.
precepts.point: The glory of the Most High is Israel, his servants, the ones keeping his laws; the nations and the enemies of the Most High shall see those Israelites rising.

note.label: Isaiah 66: The Most High's Throne, Zion's Travail, and Judgment by Fire

precepts.why:
“I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.” What is his glory? “I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.”

The glory of the Most High is Israel, his servants, the ones keeping his laws. He knows their works and their thoughts, and when he gathers all nations and tongues, the nations and the enemies of the Most High shall see those Israelites rising, salvation placed in Zion for Israel his glory.

note.label: The Keys Of Hell & Death: The Lake Of Fire

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord”: this is talking about the kingdom, so we know the kingdom is set up at this time.

Here it come: “And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me”: you broke the commandments, you rejected Christ. “For their worm shall not die”: their worm is their soul; their soul shall not die. “Neither shall their fire be quenched.”

So that’s in the kingdom, and like Abraham and Lazarus seeing the rich man across the gulf, they go forth and look upon them. When the kingdom is established, that’s why Christ said he has the keys to death and hell; when he returns, this is what he’s going to do.

note.label: The Keys Of Hell & Death: The Lake Of Fire

precepts.why: “And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me”: you break the commandments, you don’t have faith in Christ. “For their worm shall not die”: that’s your soul. “Neither shall their fire be quenched.” It’s saying the same thing as Mark 9: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

note.label: The Keys Of Hell & Death: The Lake Of Fire

precepts.why:
“They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse”. The possum is in the mouse family. You might think people don’t eat that; they do. Down south they got possum stew.

“Shall be consumed together, saith the Lord”: consumed together means destroyed together. God’s going to do a whole lot of killing when Christ returns. And look at that lobster and shrimp: hey babe, let’s go out to Red Lobster. The cockroach of the sea. All of it is the abominations in her cup.

note.label: America Is A Reflection Of Ancient Assyria | PART 2

precepts.why: Here’s another one. “The Lord will come with fire”. “And with his chariots like a whirlwind”: those are his so-called UFOs. “To render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.” “By fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.”

note.label: Pride & Divine Judgment

precepts.why:
Now don’t get mad, get glad. “And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.” The whole planet is going to be forced to observe the new moon holiday and the Sabbath; everybody’s going to be made to obey.

“And they shall go forth”: that’s the righteous shall go forth, “and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die”: their worm, that’s about their soul; it shall not die. “Neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.” You see those people over there screaming, those rebellious ones against the Lord? Everybody is going to see them spirits.

note.label: Pride & Divine Judgment

precepts.why: The great gulf fixed. “And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.” That’s Old Testament; now we’re in the New Testament saying the same thing. There’s no contradiction: they shall look upon them, and between us and them is a gulf no one can pass.

note.label: Wickedness: The Grain of Evil Seed

precepts.why: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.” Watch this: “For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.” Christ is going to kill a whole lot of people. A whole lot.

note.label: From Desolation to Dominion

precepts.why:
This is what Christians do with the Assyrian coming into our land. A Christian pastor in Texas named John Hagee uses this verse: “Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.”

They use that verse to say that’s the fulfillment of May 14th, 1948. What we read in Isaiah 66 ain’t talking about May 14th, 1948. You Michelin man, you better cut it out with your lies. They don’t want us on TV with these guys.

note.label: The Guide to Fixing a Broken People

precepts.why:
It says the same thing: they gonna choose their delusions over the truth. That’s why a lot of people just got to get burnt up, all praises to the Most High, because the only way he’s gonna be able to reset this place is through nuclear fire.

“I also will choose their delusions”: the Most High chose the delusions we’ll be under. “And will bring their fears upon them”: the oppression we’re under, he’s going to bring that on us. “Because when I called, none did answer”: when we go out there and teach, they don’t want to answer, they don’t want to hear it. “When I spake, they did not hear”: when we go out there and speak the words of God, they keep on walking. “But they did evil”: they continue to do evil; many times when we leave camp and leave from teaching on fly missions, somebody end up dead. “And chose that in which I delighted not”: they chose sin; they chose to keep smoking weed, keep selling heroin, keep selling ass.

“Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word”: those that fear God. “Your brethren that hated you”: our brothers that hated us, “that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed”. They’re going to be ashamed for the things that they’re doing.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

precepts.why:
After the seventh day, after that seventh cycle, you get a new moon. “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.” The new moon represents a new heaven and a new earth, where we are filled at the full.

“And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.” We are going to be keeping the sabbaths and new moons in the kingdom.

“And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me”: those are the foolish virgins that did not have their oil for their lamps, “for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched.”

The Sabbath represents rest, eternal rest: no more work and no more oppression for us; somebody else does the work. In the kingdom we are going to be celebrating the day the Lord gives us rest.

note.label: THE REWARD OF THE RIGHTEOUS: WHO IS REALLY GETTING IN?

precepts.why:
How will he render vengeance? “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire. For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.”

Plead means destroy. There will be a lot of dying, and the slain of the Lord shall be many. Christians never read that; it is blacked out.

note.label: THE REWARD OF THE RIGHTEOUS: WHO IS REALLY GETTING IN?

precepts.why:
The plagues of that land: “And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.”

We are going to see it: look on that land destroyed for those who transgressed against the Lord. Here in America is going to be the lake of fire. That goes back to the plagues and sicknesses the Lord lays upon that land.

note.label: Gods Memorial: The Smoke of Her Torment

precepts.why:
“For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels”. So in the Kingdom we are going to be like angels.

So in Revelation 14, when it says they shall be tormented in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb, who is that? That’s us, as the angels. That is how in Isaiah 66 we go forth and look upon the carcasses of the men that have transgressed against God.
